issues.problem: Success criterion needs executive committee approval, but the plan ends at week 17 with COO and Head of Claims approving 'for submission'; no phase sizes the committee's decision.
issues.fix: Size the committee's approval as Design work and make it the gate decision, with the committee or its representative present; if it falls after week 17, say so in notes.

issues.problem: Driver counts one unit, the whole 140-person department, so 'unit-level design' (1-2 weeks) duplicates the whole-model piece, yet W5 details design with 'each claims unit' leaders; team count is unaddressed.
issues.fix: Count claims teams under the department as a separate assumed driver with a note asking the partner to confirm it; if none exist, drop the unit-level piece and shorten Design.

issues.problem: Q5 asks what the executive committee must see, but only W7 (weeks 16-17) addresses it; nothing earlier asks anyone, and W2 interviews only the COO and Head of Claims.
issues.fix: Add a W2 activity to establish with the COO how the committee decides and what evidence it needs; build W7 and D7 from that, not from the design alone.
